thread:
maria: quick sync: proposing env-aware automatic fallback policy. defaults differ by env and tenant risk. want UX + telemetry notes.

kevin: console surfaces? per-route + tenant overrides + global defaults. show current policy, fallback % (1h/24h), simulate button.

maria: add dry-run mode that writes to simulations index, not counters.

juniper: telemetry: every decision must emit audit event with trace_id, route, decision_type, trigger_reason, explain_id. two streams: counters(always) and sampled detailed events.

kevin: API suggestion: POST /policies -> {name,rules:[{env,mode,audit_sampling,max_fallback_rate}],overrides:[{scope,id,rule_ref}]}.

maria: UX: if tenant override increases predicted fallback >10% in prod show approval required (SRE or product) and allow quick revert.

juniper: implementation caveats: keep sampling deterministic (seed in request), TTL simulation events (7d), dry-run should not affect production counters. add preview_prediction metric for simulation.

deploy-bot: policy-service canary started (canary id=policy-canary-20260321).

maria: action items: kevin api + migration, juniper runtime + sampling, maria mocks + simulate endpoint, ops define approvers. I'll post mocks in #design. :thumbsup:
